description: This file defines the JsonifiableAdaptable interface, which extends Adaptable and Jsonifiable<JsonObject>, providing methods to convert objects into JSON format with specific headers, and includes an inner static class JsonFields that defines JSON field constants.

classes.name: JsonifiableAdaptable
classes.description: An interface extending Adaptable and Jsonifiable<JsonObject>, providing methods to convert adaptable objects into JSON format.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A static inner class containing definitions for JSON fields 'topic' and 'headers'.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns this object as a JsonObject with specified headers instead of the original ones.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for this adaptable object.
